morgan (sec-eng): Heads up — scanner jobs started failing intermittently on main monorepo after yesterday's GHAS agent update. Errors look like DB lock/timeouts + some surprising high-severity Snyk flags on dev deps. Anyone seen this?

devsec-bot: Alert: scanner-job-8421 failed 2024-06-30T02:05:12Z -> exit_code=1, message="error waiting for scan lock: timed out after 30s" (link: https://ci.internal/jobs/8421) :warning:

kevin (eng-infra): Can you paste the relevant logs? Also which scanner (trivy/snyk/ghas) was running when it died?

morgan (sec-eng): Mainly GHAS orchestration kicked off trivy container + Snyk check as a follow-up. Logs: 
```
2024-06-30T02:04:46Z scan-runner[8421]: acquiring repo lock: /var/locks/scan-main
2024-06-30T02:04:46Z scan-runner[8421]: spawned worker pid=2719
2024-06-30T02:04:58Z trivy[2719]: scanning layers... (huge layer set)
2024-06-30T02:05:12Z scan-runner[8421]: error: wait_for_lock: timeout after 30s
2024-06-30T02:05:12Z scan-runner[8421]: failing scan job: cleanup and retry scheduled
```
Also Snyk produced a bunch of high severity issues from packages under `dev-tools/` that are devOnly.

sara (sre): Two quick thoughts: 1) the monorepo has grown a LOT — scanning node_modules / vendor trees in parallel saturates IO/DB locks. 2) Maybe the GHAS upgrade changed default concurrency or lock timeouts. Worth trying to reduce parallel workers and exclude dev-only folders.

jordan (product-security): For the Snyk false positives — can we push temporary suppressions in GHAS UI? We should avoid long-lived suppressions but need a stopgap so noise doesn't drown real findings. Audit trail required.

ali (platform): We should centralize suppression rules (and any mapping between GHAS/Snyk/Trivy) into an encrypted param that the scanner fetches at runtime. Proposed: store JSON suppressions in KMS-encrypted SSM parameter (kms key = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:.../scans). Scanner role needs kms:Decrypt + ssm:GetParameter. That way infra owns lifecycle and we can rotate keys.

kevin (eng-infra): Agree. Quick patch options: 
- lower scanner concurrency: `max_workers: 6` (current is 12)
- increase lock timeout to 120s as a short-term bandaid
- add `exclude_patterns: ["**/node_modules/**", "dev-tools/**"]` to monorepo rule
I'll open a small infra PR for the config change.

morgan (sec-eng): Sounds good. For suppressions: Jordan — do you want GHAS UI temporary suppressions while we implement KMS-backed mapping? If so, let's make them 7-day and tag with `sec-temporary` + issue link.

jordan (product-security): Yep — temporary GHAS suppressions for the dev-only deps. I'll create the tickets and set the expiry. Will document justification and link to migration issue.

ali (platform): For IAM/RBAC: scanner service account currently has kms:Encrypt but not kms:Decrypt. We need to add `kms:Decrypt` and `ssm:GetParameter`. I'll draft the policy in the infra PR. Note: principal constraint to the scanner role only.

morgan (sec-eng): Who owns deploy and monitoring for this change? We should do a canary deploy to 2 repos first, watch queue length and error rate.

oncall (sre-oncall): I'll watch the deploy window. Recommend deploy Wed 02:00 UTC (low traffic) and 1-hour post-deploy watch with error thresholds: >5% failed scans or >10m queue growth -> rollback.

kevin (eng-infra): PRs: infra#472 (concurrency + IAM), scanner-config#213 (exclude patterns + timeout). I'll tag reviewers @ali @sara. Planning canary to `repo-a` and `repo-b`.

morgan (sec-eng): Post-deploy followups: 
- add runbook entry for "scanner lock timeouts" (how to increase timeout, apply temp suppression, rollback PR)
- add automated job to sync GHAS suppressions into KMS weekly (to keep mappings up to date)

jordan (product-security): I'll own the runbook text + the suppression ticket list.

ali (platform): One more: encryption key rotation note — when rotating KMS key we must update scanner role policy and ensure old versions remain decryptable (use key alias). I'll add to infra PR description.

morgan (sec-eng): Great. Summary action items: 
- kevin: open infra + scanner PRs (today)
- ali: draft IAM policy change in PR, include kms:Decrypt + ssm:GetParameter (today)
- jordan: temp GHAS suppressions + tickets (today)
- oncall: watch Wed 02:00 UTC deploy (monitor thresholds)
- sara/morgan: add runbook + postmortem if failures persist

kevin (eng-infra): PRs up -> infra#472, scanner-config#213. Rolling to canary at 02:00 UTC Wed. :rocket:

morgan (sec-eng): Thanks all. If we still see lock timeouts after lowering concurrency and excludes we'll escalate to GHAS vendor. :eyes:

sara (sre): noted. I'll be on call for the window. :+1:

devsec-bot: Incident note created: INC-20240630-11 (owner: morgan) — followup tasks linked.

morgan (sec-eng): closing thread for now — will post updates after canary. :white_check_mark:
